convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom() to load ColorXADX indicator (custom indicator, not built-in), and depends on external .mqh libraries (SmoothAlgorithms.mqh, TradeAlgorithms.mqh) for smoothing algorithms and trade execution logic.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator calculation
TimeShiftSec - chart period in seconds
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for trade signal timing

other_exits: Long position closed when MPlus[1]<MMinus[1] (DI+ crosses below DI- on previous bar) if BuyPosClose enabled
Short position closed when MPlus[1]>MMinus[1] (DI+ crosses above DI- on previous bar) if SellPosClose enabled

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MM parameter: negative values represent fixed lot size (absolute value), positive values represent share of deposit in a deal. Default MM=-0.1 means fixed 0.1 lots.

custom_logic_notes: Entry uses bar[1] vs bar[0] comparison for DI crossover detection: MPlus[1]>MMinus[1] confirms crossover happened on the completed bar, while MPlus[0]<=MMinus[0] confirms the prior bar had DI+ below DI-. This is a two-bar crossover confirmation pattern. ADX must be above ExtraHighLevel as a trend strength filter. Signal is only evaluated on new bar or when Recount flag is set (retried on data copy failure). BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose are boolean gates that can disable specific directions. The TradeAlgorithms.mqh library handles actual position opening/closing with embedded position management logic.
python_conversion_notes: 1. The ColorXADX custom indicator must be reimplemented in Python - it uses the CXMA class from SmoothAlgorithms.mqh which implements T3/JurX/ParMA/VIDYA/AMA smoothing algorithms. 2. The ADX with custom smoothing (not standard Wilder smoothing) requires porting the CXMA.GetStartBars and CXMA smoothing logic. 3. TradeAlgorithms.mqh must be analyzed to understand BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/SellPositionClose/BuyPositionClose behavior - these handle the conditional MM logic (negative=lot, positive=deposit fraction) and position existence checks. 4. The two-bar crossover pattern (bar[1] vs bar[0] for directional index comparison) must be preserved exactly. 5. SL/TP values of 1000/2000 points suggest 5-digit broker context - verify if TradeAlgorithms.mqh performs digit adjustment internally. 6. SignalBar parameter allows using non-latest bar for signal generation (default=1, meaning previous completed bar).
